optional_fields.spawned_from: story_id of the parent story that spawned this one
optional_fields.spawn_phase: pipeline phase in parent where this stub was created (scope|plan|build|qa|retro)
optional_fields.spawn_reason: one-line description of why this was spawned
optional_fields.spawned_stubs: array of {story_id, phase, reason} for stubs this story spawned
optional_fields.terminal: Terminal assignment for kanban planning: A, B, or null if unassigned
optional_fields.size: T-shirt size estimate: XS, S, M, L, XL, or null if unsized
optional_fields.lane_position: integer >= 0: ordering within (domain, non-terminal). Unique across (domain, kanban != done|archived).
optional_fields.depends_on: array of story_ids that must be terminal before this story is pickable; default []
optional_fields.story_branch: the story/<id>-<slug> git branch this story's commits live on; written by scripts/story-branch.js --ensure
optional_fields.head_sha: the story-branch commit SHA whose presence on origin/main defines 'landed'; written at build-commit and refreshed by close immediately before the merge
